corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward supplies artillery lethal damage; physicians sustain actual recipients. No retreat, bait or source death cancels an existing projectile.
Midnight destroys eastern roadblock #3 while intercepting upper-outer officers; returning western Steward destroys #1 after hostile clearance.
Melantha destroys eastern roadblock #4 and kills lower-outer officers before their contact with the protected target; later she destroys western #2.
Fang supplies actual upper-central BLOCK. Midnight's available attacks and returning Steward must clear armor #21/#33 and runner backlog before two-block capacity is exceeded.
Friston supplies actual lower-central BLOCK, including #28/#31/#34. Hibiscus and Ansel preserve him; Midnight and returning Steward provide armor clearance.
Midnight blocks and kills upper-outer traffic; his own blocked targets take time away from central assistance.
Melantha remains the lower-outer blocker and damage source through the final officer; Hibiscus supplies continuous reachable healing.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-outer interception, eastern roadblock damage and intermittent central arts.
Permanent lower-outer damage, eastern roadblock clearance and possible artillery recipient.
Direct healing of Melantha, Friston, Ansel and eastern Steward.
Heal central holders, Hibiscus and Steward; skill extension reaches Midnight.
Returning arts damage covering both central holders.

formation_structure.artillery_damage_budget: At the supplied Steward damage cadence, 36 ordinary hits of 249.10 and nine enhanced hits of 473.29 total 13227.21. Forty-five artillery-directed hits are sufficient; deployment time alone does not establish contact, target allocation or lethal damage.

economy.failure_semantics: Missing Fang income, a dead retreating unit or insufficient healing is a survival/handoff failure. No future grant or refund repairs it retroactively.
economy.redeployment_basis: Supplied current-model costs remain 18 for Steward and 15 for Melantha; each scheduled redeployment waits more than 2100 frames. Refunds are 9, 9 and 7 only for successful living retreats; death refunds zero.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: Actions are fixed. Conditions are validity assertions, not conditional execution or automatic rescheduling.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Hibiscus RIGHT from [5,5] covers Melantha [6,5], Friston [4,5], Ansel [5,6] and Steward [5,7], but not Fang or Midnight. Ansel DOWN from [5,6] covers both central holders, Hibiscus and Steward; active extension reaches Midnight. No extra-heal talent is credited.
formation_structure.targeting_limit: Melantha is a possible durable recipient, not an asserted priority target. Hibiscus [5,5] may enter acquisition earlier than the baseline. Any resulting locks and splash must be evaluated at their actual coordinates.

formation_transitions.transition: Establish direct lower-lane medicine before adding the second physician; this replaces reliance on Melantha's unhealed HP pool.
Ansel supplies mutual medical recovery and central healing.
Steward enters the eastern damage station; Melantha remains deployed instead of opening a lower-outer handoff gap.
Withdraw Steward only if artillery is already dead and Steward survives; residual projectiles still resolve.
Return Steward to central coverage. Friston and Fang must have contained their queues throughout his absence.
After hostile clearance, release Steward and then Melantha for western roadblock duties.
Redeploy the two surviving clearance operators west and retain medicine until both protected arrivals are recorded.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly these seven IDs; each has catalog rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true. No reserve-mode units or aliases.
All deployment tiles are legal terrain; never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and two distinct protected arrivals.
Only deployed living operators receive skills or retreats; death invalidates dependent actions and gives no refund.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Roadblock destruction and officer removal must establish safe passage.
Do not allocate the same heal to multiple recipients or assume equal-ratio tie resolution. Melantha must actually receive Hibiscus healing.
Track every born projectile through impact; no landing tile becomes safe merely because a unit retreats or artillery dies.
Fang and Friston must actually block the required enemies and retain capacity before runners arrive; range overlap alone is insufficient.
The scheduled artillery and final-clearance retreats require observed completion of their predecessor duties.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions and both physicians. Preserve Fang's conditional income and Friston until medical coverage starts.
Survive the first actual artillery locks with HP reserves and Hibiscus's first skill; Ansel's skill is not yet available.
Maintain shared-hit recovery, eastern roadblock clearance and uninterrupted artillery-directed Steward output.
Contain both central armor waves while Steward is unavailable; use Midnight's arts without abandoning his outer lane.
Steward clears central queues, especially enemies actually held by Friston; Melantha finishes lower officers.
Clear western restraints and observe two safe arrivals. Continue beyond the nominal window if protected movement or roadblock damage is unfinished.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP only while alive and continuously deployed.
Basic blocking and attacks only; no robot talent credit.
Eastern clearance and central arts when not occupied by his own blocked targets; 40-second active periods pause SP.
Strengthen lower clearance and shorten officer contact; no manual skill is scheduled after her western redeployment.
Direct lower-recipient healing and shared medical recovery; each activation respects 20 active seconds plus 30 recovery seconds.
Central and medical recovery plus extended Midnight coverage; each cycle respects 25 active seconds plus 35 recovery seconds.
Automatic enhanced attacks and supported high-defense priority; credit only damage actually delivered to the required target.

tactical_thesis: Replace the failed western artillery station with eastern Steward output and a seven-ID permanent lower-lane structure. Eliminate Spot's separate successor role: Melantha keeps lower interception and roadblock damage, while Hibiscus at [5,5] RIGHT supplies previously missing direct lower-lane healing. Ansel at [5,6] DOWN heals Hibiscus and the central holders, with extended healing for Midnight. This is an unsimulated, falsifiable formation hypothesis: changed artillery acquisition and medical competition remain its decisive risks.
